messages:
Maria J: Quick announcement — Nightly fallback-capacity experiment scheduled Thu 2026-04-01 00:30 UTC -> 03:30 UTC for 3 nights. Goal: validate graceful-deg routing + KV cache warmup behavior under low load and measure p99 impact. This is a controlled experiment, not a maintenance: we will shift a small percentage of traffic to fallback pools and track SLO telemetry. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/fallback-capacity-experiment
Alex G: Clarifying question — what percent of traffic are we shifting in canary vs ramp?
Maria J: Canary will be 2% for the first 20m, then 10% for the next 40m, then 25% steady state for the remainder of the window if metrics look good. We will not exceed 25% at any time.
Tony (oncall): Oncall +1. I'll be watching latency and error-rate dashboards (route: /slo/fallback-experiment). Pager thresholds set in the runbook. If p99 latency > 1.5x baseline for 10m or errors > 2% we abort and rollback immediately.
Siva R: Are we applying any temporary SLO adjustments for the experiment window? Need to ensure customer SLAs don't get alarmed.
Maria J: Good point. We're adding an experiment tag to metrics and a temporary SLO advisory window in the console (no SLA change). Ops will suppress non-actionable noise alerts; critical pagers still active. Docs in runbook under "observability".
Alex G: Do we need a deploy freeze during the experiment?
Maria J: Yes — no model or runtime deployments to the affected west-1 pools from 00:00 -> 04:00 UTC. I'll post a deploy-freeze note to release-war-room as well.
ops-bot: Scheduled job created: experiment-controller will run at 2026-04-01T00:30:00Z. Controller logs will stream to #eng-sre-experiments. Job id: exp-2026-04-01-00.
deploy-bot: Reminder: deploy freeze enforced for pools: west-1-fallback, west-1-primary during experiment window.
Tony (oncall): Quick checklist for oncall: 1) Watch /slo/fallback-experiment 2) Validate KV warmup hit ratios (metric kv.cache.prefill.hit) 3) Confirm traffic shift % in controller logs 4) Run rollback if criteria hit.
Maria J: Rollback command (controller debug mode):
```
POST https://controller.internal/api/v1/experiments/exp-2026-04-01-00/abort
Authorization: Bearer <oncall-token>
```
Use only if abort conditions met. After rollback, run a 10m observation before declaring green.
Siva R: I'll coordinate with Support to pre-warn enterprise customers with dedicated capacity in west-1 — short bulletin ready if needed.
Alex G: Thanks. I'll run a dry-run locally against staging controller to validate steps.
Tony (oncall): I'll be on watch every night of experiment. Ping me @Tony if you need immediate action.
Maria J: Post-experiment tasks: 1) team sync on Monday 2026-04-06 16:00 UTC to review telemetry and decide on follow-ups 2) possible follow-up load test to exercise warmup under heavy cold-starts 3) update routing policies if we identify safe fallback thresholds.
Siva R: Added calendar event and invited the ops + runtime teams.
Alex G: :thumbsup:
Tony (oncall): Acknowledged.
Maria J: Thanks everyone — will post a short summary each morning of the run in this thread. If you see anything odd outside the abort criteria, mention it here and tag @oncall.
